purpose: Test whether the frozen two-module causal-temporal source channel improves the official PMFS localization endpoint on 30 measured historical OFF trajectories before any runtime or planner intervention is authorized.

scientific_modules.M1_causal_physical_operator: native GADEN do(S=s) physical concentration followed by the frozen run-persistent sensor operator
scientific_modules.M2_temporal_reachability_operator: right-censored ever/never evidence from the first 80 samples of each completed physical stop, with eight-member predictive nuisance marginalized inside each stop and evidence accumulated across completed stops

scope.physical_stop: one maximal contiguous is_moving=0 run; use its first 80 samples and exclude runs shorter than 80 samples
scope.visible_stop_rule: a stop is visible at update u only when the timestamp of its 80th sample is no later than the frozen PMFS source-update timestamp

frozen_inputs.schedule_mapping_rule: each historical OFF sim_pose_trace SHA-256 and row count must equal the same House/seed train stream in bank_summary.json
frozen_inputs.source_update_rule: use the five existing source_update_timing.csv rows and matching source_posterior.csv snapshots without modification

frozen_inference.predictive_probability: p[s,b] = (0.5 + sum over eight train members E[s,m,b]) / 9
frozen_inference.candidate_log_score: L_t[s] = sum over completed visible stops b of E_obs[b] log p[s,b] + (1-E_obs[b]) log(1-p[s,b])
frozen_inference.geometry_prior: one equal prior quantum per native free PMFS cell; carrier q0 mass is proportional to its count of free cells
frozen_inference.source_channel_replacement: q_CTRE_t[s] is proportional to q0[s] exp(L_t[s]); the native PMFS posterior is never multiplied into q_CTRE because it already consumed the same measured observations
frozen_inference.cell_projection: each cell receives its equal cell prior times its carrier likelihood, followed by one normalization
frozen_inference.sequential_contract: multiplying only newly completed-stop likelihoods into the previous CTRE posterior must equal recomputing q0 times all visible-stop likelihoods

official_endpoint.name: ExpectedValue(sourceProbability,0.05)
official_endpoint.ordering: descending posterior probability with native ascending cell_index as the frozen exact-tie order
official_endpoint.error: Euclidean distance from the posterior-weighted selected-cell centroid to truth_eval_only

tie_artifact_guard.reason: carrier likelihoods are constant within a carrier, so the top-five-percent boundary can bisect an exact tie
tie_artifact_guard.symmetrized_endpoint: select all cells strictly above the boundary and the same fractional inclusion of every boundary-tied cell needed to reach the official selected-cell count
tie_artifact_guard.reverse_order_endpoint: repeat the official endpoint with descending cell_index as the exact-tie order
tie_artifact_guard.fixed_random_sensitivity: also report sixteen SHA256-domain-separated fixed exact-tie orders without using them to choose a favorable result
tie_artifact_guard.status: canonical, reverse-order and symmetrized endpoints are co-primary artifact guards; none can rescue another failed endpoint

truth_separation.stage_1: read only train8 bank, support geometry, pose, update timing and measured_gas_ppm; write and SHA-256 freeze all 150 FULL and temporal-control carrier scores/posteriors
truth_separation.stage_2: reload the exact Stage-1 artifact by hash, then and only then read native source_posterior.csv and case_result.json truth_eval_only
truth_separation.rule: Stage 2 refuses an unfrozen or hash-mismatched Stage-1 artifact
truth_separation.truth_use: endpoint evaluation, true-carrier rank diagnostics, catastrophe and false-confident-collapse classification only

temporal_increment_controls.count_only: retain only the number of observed reached stops and each candidate's mean reachability probability over the visible stops; discard physical-stop identity
temporal_increment_controls.stop_label_permute: within each visible prefix, apply a deterministic SHA256-domain-separated non-identity permutation to candidate stop labels while leaving observed stop labels fixed
temporal_increment_controls.hard_requirement: FULL final pooled error must be no greater than both controls under canonical and tie-symmetrized endpoints; otherwise M2 has not shown incremental value

source_label_null.mapping: one deterministic SHA256-domain-separated non-identity permutation per House/replicate, shared across its ten runs; permute frozen carrier score labels while leaving q0, cell geometry, trajectories and PMFS comparator fixed
source_label_null.statistic: pooled relative final-error improvement over native PMFS

catastrophe_definition: CTRE error is more than PMFS error plus 1.0 m and also greater than 1.5 times PMFS error
false_confident_collapse_definition: posterior variance is below 1.0 m^2 while official error exceeds 2.0 m
forbidden: using true_gas_ppm, a PMFS posterior, source truth or localization error to form CTRE evidence
multiplying CTRE likelihood into the native PMFS posterior
retaining one coherent turbulent member identity across physical stops
changing threshold, sensor constants, stop length, member count, prior, likelihood, endpoint, Gate or source support after outcome read
calling a fixed-trajectory shadow a closed-loop result
treating the ten repeated trajectories with one fixed source in a House as ten independent source-generalization units
authorizing runtime or paired closed loop after any hard-rule failure
downstream: Only PASS permits immutable runtime lookup/single-consumption integration followed by H01/H02/H03 seeds1-3 paired 300-s OFF versus ON closed loop.
